Emma Andrews has stepped down as CEO, President, and director, with CFO and director Sam Kassem appointed interim CEO effective immediately.
Andrews, who joined Nextleaf eight years ago and became CEO in September 2023, will remain with the company under an advisory arrangement during the transition.
Kassem, who has served as CFO since September 2023 and a director since December 2023, has more than a decade of cannabis industry experience, including senior roles in Canada and the U.S.

title: Nextleaf names CFO Sam Kassem interim CEO
